The room

Built by hand, floor to ceiling.

Melissa spent four months turning the space on Initial Ave into the Hive — late nights, two local builders, her own artwork on the walls — and opened the doors in June 2025. That fall, Elycia brought Raven Collective and twenty years of loyal clients under the same roof.

The result is a salon that feels like somebody's living room: grey shiplap, a honeycomb shelf, propagation tubes on the wall, an emerald Chesterfield by the window, and enough plants that the sign on the shelf reads "it's not hoarding, it's plants."

Ready when you are

Come sit. Stay a while.
